round_interpretation: Round two increased hypervolume by 17.89%. Replacing HY change with HY level on the rank-free parent raised IC by 0.075 in all three seeds and nearly retained Sharpe, but worsened NLL by 0.125351. Trend removal yielded a six-input frontier point. Replacing annual CPI with monthly CPI created a density-edge tradeoff with much worse IC/Sharpe. Replacing curve with yield level and adding lag/volatility/flow were not competitive in that context. The final family round prunes and bridges the high-IC credit-level branch and six-input branch; it does not force a lag-free or single-credit representation.
default_expected_tradeoff: Evaluate the complete IC/NLL/Sharpe vector, seed stability and calibration; input savings and interval width are diagnostic descriptors, never hidden objectives.
default_falsification: A dominated result does not support the proposed conditional improvement. A density cost cannot veto a genuine IC/Sharpe tradeoff, and the family round cap does not establish global optimality.
